protocol.experiment: Regeneration R5: Replications 2/3 donor_electron 4q GHZ DQN
protocol.env: SiliQunEnv(device='donor', n_qubits=4, target_state='ghz', max_steps=50, fidelity_threshold=0.99, sim_mode='mps')
protocol.action_space: Discrete(23): 16 rotations RX/RY(pi/2,pi) x 4 qubits, 6 CNOT/CZ on pairs (0-1,1-2,2-3), 1 idle RZ(0)
protocol.algo: SB3 DQN MlpPolicy [128,128] x2, buffer 1e5, train_freq 1, gradient_steps 1, target_update_interval 1000, eps 0.9->0.05 linear
protocol.device: CPU (no CUDA backend in env step path; 4q MPS is numpy-exact)
